definitions.explanation: The way one lives or earns a living.
One's daily life and how it is conducted.

notes:
{暮|く}らし describes how one lives day-to-day.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {暮|く}らし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧ (life is easy/hard)
- {暮|く}らし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make a living)
- {暮|く}らし⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧ (living conditions)

AS SUFFIX (becomes ぐらし):
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{暮|ぐ}らし (living alone)
- ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧{暮|ぐ}らし (living as a couple)
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧{暮|ぐ}らし (country living)
- ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧{暮|ぐ}らし (city living)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live)
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (life, livelihood - more formal)
